Developer quickstart

Copy this snippet to get started with our inference API. See the [full quickstart](https://docs.together.ai/docs/quickstart) for more details.

Python

TypeScript

cURL

```
from together import Together

client = Together()

completion = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="moonshotai/Kimi-K3",
    messages=[\
        {\
            "role": "user",\
            "content": "What are the top 3 things to do in New York?",\
        }\
    ],
)

print(completion.choices[0].message.content)
```

```
import Together from 'together-ai';
const together = new Together();

const completion = await together.chat.completions.create({
  model: 'moonshotai/Kimi-K3',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Top 3 things to do in New York?' }],
});

console.log(completion.choices[0].message.content);
```

Our models

Together AI hosts many popular models, available via serverless or dedicated model inference. On serverless, you're charged based on the tokens you use and the size of the model. On dedicated, you're charged based on GPU hours.
